svg.title: agente-analista-sql-local
svg.desc: Local AI data analyst that answers Spanish or English questions about Ecuadorian public procurement data. Its path is understand, retrieve, generate SQL, validate, execute, chart and narrate.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Ask in Spanish or English about Ecuadorian public procurement data.
Get the answer, the SQL, a table and a chart. Everything runs on your machine.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
